instructionsHtml:
This is an interactive lesson. The right panel contains your interactive content area.

Right now it shows a placeholder. Replace PlaceholderPanel with your own component to build real exercises. See architecture.md for step-by-step instructions.

Completing this lesson

The checklist below tracks your progress. The placeholder panel auto-completes all items so you can see how the flow works before wiring up a real engine.
